verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no standalone desktop app. 2FAS lists its surfaces as iOS, Android and browser extensions, and the extensions are phone-tethered: tokens must be confirmed in the mobile app, and vault items are retrieved from the phone on demand. That is an adjacent companion feature, not a first-class desktop app that works independently of mobile, so the axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
